mechanism: Retain C1 leg references and add the existing FPS heading outer loop: integrate operator yaw-rate into an independent heading reference, then command raw yaw-rate plus 3/s times wrapped heading error, bounded +/-1.5rad/s. Baseline explicitly removes heading error from K; C1 actually yawed ~0.737rad. This tests that measured drift without guessing a velocity estimator correction.

yaw torque demand and actual requested common/differential wheel torque
execution_rule: One fresh case at a time; inspect before the next. Failure of first slow case pauses all others. Never rerun consumed IDs or revise gates.
notes: Candidate1 and all old failures remain frozen.
Only heading feedback is new control logic. Added logs never feed the controller.
Packet timestamp is queue epoch, not proof of instantaneous coherence across IMU boxcar/encoder/torque channels.
This is T01-only and not a self-spin, air-mode or moving-jump qualification.
